1.5 審查程序 Application Review Process
外國學生入學申請，申請人應依本校招生簡章規定，於指定期間向本校國際合作事務處
（以下簡稱國合處）提出申請。Applicants should follow the regulations outlined in NCCU
admissions brochure and submit their applications to the Office of International Cooperation
(OIC) within the designated period.
國合處就申請人國籍及學歷是否符合外國學⽣⾝分進行初審；初審合格者送各系所複
審；經各系所或學程審查合格者，再交由審查小組審查之。The office conducts an initial
review of the applicants' nationality and educational background to determine their eligibility
as international students. Those who pass the initial review will proceed to the department-
level review conducted by respective departments or programs. Candidates who are approved
by the departments or programs will then be forwarded to the admissions committee for further
evaluation.
前項審查⼩組由業務主管副校⻑、教務⻑、國合⻑、各相關學院院⻑及相關系所或學程
主管組成，並由副校⻑召集之。審查合格者，由校⻑核定後，發給入學許可，通知入
學。The admissions committee is composed of the Vice President in charge of international
affairs, the Dean of Academic Affairs, the Vice president for International Cooperation, the
deans of relevant colleges, and the directors of relevant departments or programs. The
committee is convened by the Vice President. Once the applicants pass the review, their
admissions will be approved by the President, and they will be issued an admission letter,
notifying them of their acceptance.

Representative Offices.

circumstances are discovered after graduation, NCCU shall revoke the student’s graduation
eligibility and rescind any degree already awarded.

information in the NCCU Online Application System shall have their admission revoked. If
the student has already registered, their student status shall be cancelled, and they shall not
be awarded any academic certification. If such circumstances are discovered after
graduation, NCCU shall revoke the student’s graduation eligibility and rescind any degree
already awarded.

外國學生入學申請，申請人應依本校招生簡章規定，於指定期間向本校國際合作事務
處提出申請。本處就申請人國籍及學歷是否符合外國學生⾝分進行初審；初審合格送
各系所複審；經各系所或學程審查合格者再交由審查小組審查之。前項審查小組由業
務主管副校⻑、教務⻑、國合⻑、各相關學院院⻑及相關系所或學程主管組成，並由
副校⻑召集之。審查合格者，由校⻑核定後，發給入學許可，通知入學。
Applicants should follow the regulations outlined in NCCU admissions brochure and
submit their applications to the Office of International Cooperation (OIC) within the
designated period. The office conducts an initial review of the applicants' nationality and
educational background to determine their eligibility as international students. Those who
pass the initial review will proceed to the department-level review conducted by respective
departments or programs. Candidates who are approved by the departments or programs
will then be forwarded to the admissions committee for further evaluation.
The admissions committee is composed of the Vice President in charge of international
affairs, the Dean of Academic Affairs, the Vice president for International Cooperation, the
deans of relevant colleges, and the directors of relevant departments or programs. The
committee is convened by the Vice President. Once the applicants pass the review, their
admissions will be approved by the President, and they will be issued an admission letter,
notifying them of their acceptance.

Admitted applicants can enroll only after they have submitted the photocopies of their
diploma, certificate of degree conferral (applicable to applicants with a bachelor’s degree or
above from an institution in Mainland China, which is specifically recognized by the MOE)
as well as a full academic transcript and other relevant academic certificates. In addition, all

a.持國外學歷者，應依教育部『大學辦理國外學歷採認辦法』規定辦理。畢業證書及歷

Students whose degrees are conferred by foreign schools (excluding the schools in Hong
Kong, Macau, and Mainland China) shall follow the “Regulations Regarding the
Assessment and Recognition of Foreign Academic Credentials for Institutions of Higher
Education.” The diploma and the full academic transcripts are required to be verified by the
Taiwan Overseas Representative Offices in the country in which the degree-issuing school
is located. If the original documents are not in Chinese or English, a Chinese or English
translation, verified by the Taiwan Overseas Representative Offices, is also required.
b.持香港或澳門學歷者，應依『香港或澳門學歷檢覈及採認辦法』規定辦理。
The students whose degrees are conferred by the prescribed schools in Hong Kong or
Macau shall follow the “Academic Credential Verification and Accreditation Methods
adopted in Hong Kong and Macao” for the requirement of relevant academic certificates.
c.持大陸地區學歷者，應依『大陸地區學歷採認辦法』規定辦理。
Students whose degrees are conferred by the schools in Mainland China, which are
specifically recognized by MOE, shall follow the “The Regulations Governing the
Accreditation of Schools in Mainland China” for the requirement of relevant academic
certificates.

1.10. 其他申請注意事項 Miscellaneous
(1) 申請時請務必詳閱本簡章，以保自身權益。
Please read this brochure carefully in order to complete all steps regarding your application
to NCCU successfully.
(2) 申請不限⼀系/所/學程，但僅能擇⼀系所學程辦理報到及註冊入學。
An applicant may apply to more than one department/graduate institute/program. Yet, he/she
can only choose to enroll in one department/graduate institute or program.
(3) 務必自行注意申請資格、申請系所學程的各項規定，例如：應繳文件、口試、筆試及其
舉行時間。
Applicants must not only pay attention to the general admission requirements, but shall also
note the eligibility and requirements set up by individual departments/graduate institutes or
program they apply to, such as additionally requested application materials, oral tests, written
tests, etc., and provide required documents.
(4) 各系所招生名額包含ICDF(International Cooperation and Development Fund)名額，且各
系所名額得互為流用。
The admission quota of each department and graduate institute includes an admission quota
for ICDF scholarship applicants. Yet, the admission quota can be reallocated by the
Admission Committee if necessary.
(5) 依據本校外語課程限修辦法第二條：本校國際學生不得選修其國籍之官方語言或主要使
用語言相同之大學部語文課程。
According to article 2 of NCCU’s Guidelines for Restrictions on Studying Foreign Language
Courses, international students enrolled in the school are not allowed to take undergraduate
foreign language courses which are the official languages of their countries or other
languages that are their native languages.
(6) 依教育部規定，外國學生來臺就學後，其於就學期間許可在臺初設戶籍登記、戶籍遷入
登記、歸化或回復中華⺠國國籍者，喪失外國學生⾝分，應予退學；外國學生經入學學
校以操行、學業成績不及格或因犯刑事案件經判刑確定致遭退學者，不得再依「外國學
生來臺就學辦法」申請入學。違反規定經查證屬實者，取消其入學資格。
According to the regulations of the MOE (Ministry of Education), those who have been
approved to make Initial Household Registration, Moving-in Registration, or Acquisition or
Restoration of Nationality during their study in Taiwan and have thus ceased to possess the
status as foreign students, shall be dismissed from any school they are attending. Moreover,
those who withdraw or are dismissed from school in the Republic of China due to
misbehavior, unacceptable academic performance or a conviction under Criminal Law may
thereafter not apply again for admission under “Regulations Regarding International Students
Undertaking Studies in Taiwan.” Violation of the regulations, once confirmed, will result in
the cancellation of an application for admission.
(7) 依衛生福利部疾病管制署規定，凡申請來臺居留簽證，須檢具麻疹及德國麻疹抗體陽性
報告或預防接種證明。有關申請居留簽證所需健康檢查合格證明，詳請參閱外交部領事
事務局網站（http://www.boca.gov.tw）。

數相同或學分數、學期數較多之相同名稱科目時，修習前需經本系同意，並依本表規定採計學分。

學分認定為選修學分。

全民國防教育軍事訓練及體育選修課不採計為本系畢業學分。

通過者應自費修習本校華語特別班四學期（每學期一門）且及格。
Specific Regulations：
1. Students of diplomacy major should complete 51 required credits, 28 general education credits, 4
physical education credits, and 45 elective credits. Credits that exceed 51 required ones will be
recognized as electives. The department recognizes credits acquired through double major, minors,
and credits programs as electives.
2.Students should take the required courses and required elective courses offered by the Department of
Diplomacy. A student should obtain approval in advance if the student has special reasons to take the
required courses from other departments. Such courses should bear the same name with the required
courses in our department, and the credit hours should be the same or above. Once approved, the
course in question will be recognized as the required course of the Department of Diplomacy. The
department will only approve the credits that are listed on our required courses list. If the
out-of-department course is a two-semester course and our required course only has one semester,
the student should complete the course for two semesters. The department will only count the first
semester as required credits. The credits of the second semester will be recognized as electives.
3. With the exception of Regional Studies (required elective course), the department will not offer the
required courses to non-Diplomacy major students. This restriction does not apply to students with
double major and/or minor of the Department of Diplomacy.
4. Defense education and military training elective credits and physical education elective credits do not
count toward the major in Department of Diplomacy.
5. According to the “NCCU Admission Guidelines for International Students”, international students are
required to pass the Test of Chinese as a Foreign Language (TOCFL) at Level 2 before graduation. If
students fail to acquire the certificate at the required level, they will have to take and pass four
semesters of NCCU Mandarin Special Course (one course per semester) at their own expense before
graduation.

text:

Date 2018-04-10

In late March, playing the role of the Guatemalan Permanent Mission to the United Nations (UN), 18 undergraduate and MA students from Department of Diplomacy, National Chengchi University (NCCU) received the “Distinguished Delegation Award” from the 2018 National Model United Nations (NMUN) in New York City, a 5-day international conference that has invited the largest number of students from all over the world to join a model-UN simulation. They, along with more than 2,000 fellow students, participated in various meetings such as the UN General Assembly, the Commission on the Status of Women, the Commission on Narcotic Drugs, the UN Environment Assembly, and International Organization for Migration, and joined the closing ceremony at the UN General Assembly Hall on March 29, 2018.

It is the 14th time for Department of Diplomacy to participate in NMUN activities in New York.

During the 6 months’ hard, intensive and consistent work, which required the students to gather two to three times a week, the Department of Diplomacy delegation also attended a lecture given by Mr. Adolfo Sun (孫大成), former Republic of China ambassador to Guatemala (2008-2015) in late December of 2017, and some of them called on Ms. Olga Maria Aguja, Ambassador of Republic of Guatemala to the Republic of China in early March of this year.

With responsibility, devotion and commitment, the 18 delegates led and advised by a faculty member Kwei-Bo Huang (黃奎博), Vice Dean of NCCU College of International Affairs who was once on public service leave in the Foreign Affairs Ministry, got involved in different working groups with other country delegations at NMUN. With all the hard work before and during NMUN, this delegation proudly stood up in the UN General Assembly and received the applause from other delegates for its “Distinguished Delegation Award.” Of all Asian universities attending NMUN between March 25 and March 29, NCCU was the only higher education institution that was given this award. 

In New York, this delegation paid a visit to Taipei Economic and Cultural Office (TECO) in New York on March 25 and met with Director-General Lily Hsu (徐儷文). On March 28 in the evening, the delegates went to New York University’s School of Professional Studies (Center for Global Affairs) for a panel discussion on cross-Taiwan Strait business opportunities and challenges in the era of anti-globalization. 

On March 30, first time in the history of Department of Diplomacy’s NMUN delegation, Professor Huang led the delegates to Washington, DC to engage another learning experience in foreign affairs and democracy. To familiarize the delegates with foreign affairs and/or internships at Washington think tanks, visits to Deputy Representative Christine Hsueh (薛美瑜) at Taipei Economic and Cultural Representative Office (TECRO) in the United States, to Professor Robert Sutter at the George Washington University Elliott School of International Affairs, Miss Jennifer Mason at Brookings Institution Center for East Asian Policy Studies (CEAPS) were well arranged.

Wanting to take advantage of numerous historic or famous places in relation to US democracy and its development and promotion, the delegates stopped at George Washington’s Mount Vernon, Lincoln Memorial, National Museum of American History, the US Capitol, the Washington Monument, and the Vietnam Veterans Memorial, as well as visited Center for International Private Enterprises (CIPE), one of the core institutes of the National Endowment for Democracy. 

In Washington, the delegation also joined a panel on Taiwan-United States relations and a dinner banquet hosted by the Taiwan Benevolent Association (TBA) Greater Washington Chapter. There they met quite a few NCCU alumni, including Ms. Elaine Chang (張慧玲), president of NCCU Alumni Association in Metro Washington, DC.

Andy Jian (簡平帆), the head delegate, said all student delegates kept eyes wide open during the whole trips. He believed not only was this trip absolutely worthwhile, but it has also had a strong impact on the delegates’ future career development. 

At U.N. General Assembly Hall, March 29, 2018

At Center for International Private Enterprises (CIPE), April 3, 2018

At Taipei Economic and Cultural Representative Office (TECRO) in the U.S., April 2, 2018

Date 2022-05-30

[Introducing Jury Systems in East Asia and Beyond - online forum by Professor Rieko Kage](https://diplomacy.nccu.edu.tw/upload/28/doc/17276/event poster.png)

Title: Who Judges?  Introducing Jury Systems in East Asia and Beyond

Time: 9 am, June 14th 2022

Venue: Cisco Webex Virtual Meeting Room (Online)

 

Guest speaker short bio:

Rieko Kage is professor of Political Science at the Department of Advanced Social and International Studies, University of Tokyo.  She received her Bachelor's at Kyoto University and her Ph.D. at Harvard University.  She is the author of the books Civic Engagement in Postwar Japan: The Revival of a Defeated Society (Cambridge University Press, 2011), and Who Judges?  Designing Jury Systems in Japan, East Asia, and Europe (Cambridge University Press, 2017).  Kage has published widely on issues relating to civic engagement, public opinion, immigration, and Japanese politics in the British Journal of Political Science, Comparative Political Studies, Electoral Studies, and Political Psychology, among other journals.

Date 2021-09-15

The Department of Diplomacy at National Chengchi University (NCCU) invites applications for the faculty position of International Relations to begin in February or August 2022. The department is recruiting a new faculty member with a Ph.D. degree in International Political Economy, International Development, and International Law. Candidates in the final stage of completing their degree requirements should hold the certified Ph.D. degree before January 15th, 2022. 

 

The department is seeking a candidate whose teaching and research interests in IPE, Non-traditional Security, and International Development. A regional focus on Latin America that complements our existing faculty’s teaching and research interests will be an asset. The candidate should have strong capability to teach courses and publish academic works in English as well.

 

NCCU is equipped with high-quality research and is also one of the best academic institutions in Taiwan with excellent faculties specialized in International Politics and Regional Studies. NCCU is also known for having the best degree programs in Humanities, Social Sciences, and Business Studies in East Asia. In addition, the school libraries hold one of the most comprehensive collections in Humanities and Social Sciences. There are more than 2,290 Western language periodicals, 102,773 Chinese/Japanese/Korean bound periodicals, and 39,582 e-journals. We believe these rich research resources will provide a studious atmosphere to conduct research.

 

Please mail the CV, a list of publications within last five years, a certified diploma and official transcripts from college to Ph.D. degree, a copy of the Ph.D. dissertation and writing samples, and two recommendation letters to the following address by post no later than November 19th, 2021. Once we receive your application, the committee will start to review the application materials immediately in order to determine short-list candidates for the job talk.

 

Department of Diplomacy, National Chengchi University, No. 64, Sec. 2, Zhinan Rd., Taipei, Taiwan 11605, R.O.C. 

 

Shortlisted candidates will be invited to an interview. Further information is available by contacting Ms. Yi-Hsuan Chen at 886-2-2939-3091 Ext. 50916, sending an e-mail to [dip50916@nccu.edu.tw](mailto:dip50916@nccu.edu.tw), or visiting our website at [http://diplomacy.nccu.edu.tw](http://diplomacy.nccu.edu.tw)

Date 2022-07-22

【Recruitment of 2022 SEASAT camp Counselor】  

 

To young leaders out there: Join us as the camp counselor for an exciting summer!

 

The SEASAT Youth Camp, which is co-organized by the American Institute in Taiwan(AIT) and the Taiwan-Asia Exchange Foundation(TAEF), has the objective to enrich young people, from the age of 18 to 24, in their familiarity with their ASEAN, South Asian, and Taiwanese neighbors with the hopes of promoting better understanding and cooperation among international youths. Youth leaders explore ways in which the younger generation has responded to urgent issues both locally and globally through innovative projects and design their own practical agendas so that voices from the youth can be heard.

To know more about the event, please see the agenda:

[https://docs.google.com/document/d/1lL2uyDFousUXSSs37ZGu-aoDRkf0WaFI/edit?usp=sharing&ouid=113016850758199105077&rtpof=true&sd=true](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1lL2uyDFousUXSSs37ZGu-aoDRkf0WaFI/edit?usp=sharing&ouid=113016850758199105077&rtpof=true&sd=true) 

A new edition of the SEASAT Youth Camp is coming on August 3-5 at Green World Hotel NanGang (528, Sec. 7, Zhongxiao E. Rd., Nangang Dist., Taipei City 115, Taiwan)

 

For those who study international politics and aspire to devote themselves to related careers in the future, we highly recommend you to apply. You can not only better understand the work of think tanks, but also cultivate the literacy and ability to lead and advocate in international exchanges join with joining this event as camp counselor. Now, it's time for you to show your leadership!

 

Those who attend the event will be provided with the following treatments by the organizer: 

-Free lodging from 3th to 5th August, 2022 in a 2 or 3-person room at Green World Hotel NanGang (528, Sec. 7, Zhongxiao E. Rd., Nangang Dist., Taipei City 115, Taiwan)

-Standard meals and refreshments

-Local insurance in the event of unforeseen accidents.

-Local transportation for camp-related activities.

And you will also enjoy wonderful and fulfilling sessions and activities given by professional and prestigious speakers from NGOs, Academia and thinktanks.

-In the sessions, we will learn and share the issues covering “digital,” “education,” “migrants,” “ocean,” “culture,” “resilience,” “activism,” “communication,” and “youth”.The event is going to begin on August 3 at Green World Hotel NanGang.

 

The major responsibilities of the positions will include:

→→To guide group members through discussion.

→→To handle the administrative needs of group members.

→→To record the participation of members.

→→ To assist the organizer in assigning matters

→→Other assignments during the event.

→→Please note that the counselor will be required to attend some working meetings prior to the camp.

This engagement will be absolutely remunerated. Since you have the passion, the experience, and the skills it takes, sign up now! Mail your English CV to the email address: [jo11382001@taef.org](mailto:jo11382001@taef.org)

Note: Foreign students who would like to apply must have a work permit certificate.

Date 2022-03-22

On March 17th, 2022, Mr. Nadav Eyal was invited to share his insight based on his latest published book “Revolt: The Worldwide Uprising Against Globalization”. As one of the most well-known journalists winning the Sokolov Prize, Israel’s Pulitzer, Mr. Eyal works as a senior columnist for “YEDIOT ANRONOT” daily newspaper and an analyst for “RESHET NEWS TV”. 

The forum focused on the globalization issue based on Mr. Eyal’s extensive experience. Professor Cho-Hsin Su (蘇卓馨), the Director of IMPIS(International Master’s Program in International Studies) and Professor Yeh-Chung Lu (盧業中), the director of the Department of Diplomacy started the forum with a welcome speech and introduction for the seminar. Professor Mei-Chuan Wei (魏玫娟) from Graduate Institute of Development Studies and Professor Tzu-Chi Ou (歐子綺) from International College of Innovation were invited to have deep discussion with Mr.Eyal. 

Mr. Omer Caspi, the representative of the Israel Economic and Cultural Office in Taipei, with his wife, Mrs. Galit Caspi, also attended to support the international academic forum between Israel and Taiwan. He said it is a great honor for him to open this seminar and celebrate Nadav Eyal’s new book launch in Taiwan. “It is a great experience to have this opportunity to cooperate with a Taiwanese academic institution and to allow Taiwanese and Israeli experts to communicate with each other.”

In particular, Nadav Eyal drew the listeners’ attention to the phenomenon of nationalism, radicalism, and populism over the past few years; an anti-globalization trend has significantly affected the global economic, cultural and political order. With his journalist background, Mr. Eyal’s book covers many fascinating stories, including a company migrating from Syria to Germany, Neo-Nazi in Germany and cases in Greece, etc. The speaker started his expression with a brief introduction of the book and his observation on the issue related to globalization. Combining the current international status, he also shared his point of view on the role of Israel in the Ukrainian-Russian War and Israel's Foreign Policy.

After Mr. Eyal gave his insights of general observations to the element of his book, Prof. Wei gave the remarks related to the 2018 election of Kaohsiung's Mayor to echo the populism phenomena in Taiwan. She believed that the liberal global order should embody the global consensus and be sustained by common beliefs on the values of such global order. Therefore, the implication of such a view is that if the majority of the population of the world do believe in the value of the liberal global order and have formed the consensus on this, then the order would continue to rise and survive.

Both Prof. Wei and Prof. Ou montioned that the term “the age of responsibility” is very crucial to the main argument presented in the book, and they reminded us to rethink this concept. Responsibility is very determinant for the survival and maintenance of the liberal globalization. Professors believed that we do have to discuss more on questions like “what kind of responsibilities should be?”, and “Who should be responsible”. Only when we have more insights on the topic, the liberal globalization could sustain successfully.

This was a very wonderful event that Mr. Eyal helped provoke our thoughts on globalization and populism. With the forum, we knew that globalization promotes human interaction in a lot of fields, but meanwhile, Mr. Eyal pointed out that we should also reflect on the negative impact of globalization on us. We really appreciate the sharing of Mr. Eyal and all the support from the Israel Economic and Cultural Office in Taipei. We look forward to the further discussions on relevant topic in the furture.

(Photo 2: numerous guests attended the meeting, including Director of IMPIS Dr. Cho- Hsin Su (first from left), Representative of Israel Economic and Cultural Office in Taipei Omer Caspi (second from left), Director of Department of Diplomacy Dr. Yeh-Chung Lu (third from left)

 

 

 

 

(Photo 3 : full house for the forum)

Title: Journalism in Social Crisis 2022

Time: May 28th-29th, 2022 

Venue: Zoom Webinar (Online)

Speakers: Please see attached file for more information

 

The Foundation for Excellent Journalism Award holds the 2022 Asia Journalism Forum. Due to the pandemic, the two-day conference will be held online. Guest speakers in the conference include excellent journalists and experts around Asia. To name but a few: Maria Ressa, a Filipina Nobel Peace Prize winner who will discuss about post president election political situation in the Philippines; Aye Min Thant, a journalist form Frontier Myanmar who will talk about journalism environment in Myanmar under the control of military junta; Yoichiro Tateiwa, executive editor of InFact who will criticize on how media has turned into government's propaganda machine.

Date 2022-09-19

Faculty Position Announcement

National Chengchi University (NCCU), Taipei, Taiwan

 

The Department of Diplomacy at National Chengchi University (NCCU) invites applications for a faculty position in international relations beginning in February or August 2023. The department is recruiting a faculty member in international law, international political economy and/or international development. Candidates in the final stage of completing their degree requirements should possess a PhD one month prior to the start date. 

 

The department encourages all qualified applicants to apply. However, candidates with research and teaching expertise in international law, IPE, and/or international development are more welcome. In terms of areas of specialization, the department prefers the candidates who can teach Asia-Pacific or Middle East that complements our existing teaching and research interests. The candidate will be expected to teach courses and publish academic works in English as well.

 

NCCU is one of the best academic institutions in Taiwan with excellent faculties specialized in international politics and area studies. NCCU is also known for having the best degree programs in humanities, social sciences, and business studies in East Asia. In addition, the school libraries hold one of the most comprehensive collections in humanities and social sciences. 

 

Required Documents:

Curriculum Vitae

A list of publications within five years

Certified diploma

All transcripts from bachelor to PhD degree

Copy of PhD dissertation

Writing samples 

Two reference letters

 

Please mail all documents to the following address by post no later than 5:00 pm, November 21st, 2022. Once we receive your application, the committee will start to review the materials immediately in order to determine short-list candidates for the job talk.

 

Department of Diplomacy, National Chengchi University, No. 64, Sec. 2, Zhinan Rd., Taipei, Taiwan 11605, R.O.C. 

 

Shortlisted candidates will be invited to an interview. Date 2025-10-14

[From Berlin to Vienna Exploring Taiwan's Ties with Germany and Austria-s](https://diplomacy.nccu.edu.tw/upload/28/doc/36505/國際事務學院聯合導師活動 From Berlin to Vienna Exploring Taiwan's Ties with Germany and Austria-s.jpg)

[Registration Information](https://reurl.cc/z5vb87)

This event aims to deepen the understanding among students from Taiwan, Germany, and other countries regarding Germany and Austria’s politics, economy, culture, and their interactions with Taiwan. Taiwan’s interactions with Europe—geographically distant across the Eurasian continent—have remained relatively limited. In recent years, however, as global geopolitics are being reshuffled and the international landscape grows increasingly complex, Taiwan’s engagement with Europe and other like-minded regions sharing similar values has become ever more important. Yet, mutual understanding and exchange between Taiwan and European nations have not advanced fast enough to keep pace with these global developments.

We invite three professionals from Germany and Austria to share their insights, enhancing the understanding of NCCU students and the general public regarding both countries and their bilateral relations with Taiwan.

The lecture features three distinguished speakers from Germany and Austria, who will offer in-depth discussions on politics, economics, and cultural exchange:

Julian Goldmann (Head of Education and Science Section, German Institute Taipei) — Germany–Taiwan Political Relations

Nico Cron (Senior Manager for Market Entry, German Trade Office Taipei) — Germany–Taiwan Economic and Trade Cooperation

Christian Helbig (Director, Austrian Office Taipei) — Austria–Taiwan Cultural Exchange

The session will be moderated by Assistant Professor Pei-Lun Tsai from the Department of Diplomacy.

Amid today’s rapidly changing international environment, ties and cooperation between Taiwan and European countries are of growing importance. We invite participants to explore European affairs, and deepen their understanding of Germany and Austria.

All faculty and students are warmly invited to join us in broadening our horizons.

The venue will open for admission at 9:30 a.m., and the event will begin promptly at 9:50. Please be seated early.

 

Speaker: Julian Goldmann, Nico Cron, Christian Helbig

Head of Education and Science Section, German Institute Taipei. Senior Manager for Market Entry, German Trade Office Taipei. Director, Austrian Office Taipei

Qualifications:

Teaching Ability: Capable of teaching in English.

Start Date: August 1, 2025

Two recommendation letters (can be written in English or Chinese; must be sent directly by the recommenders to the email: dip50916@nccu.edu.tw or mailed to the "Faculty Recruitment Committee, Department of Diplomacy, National Chengchi University").

[Ann Fitz-Gerald Lecture](https://diplomacy.nccu.edu.tw/upload/28/doc/33300/AnnFitz-Gerald.png)

Topic: Geopolitical Trends, Technology, and the Future of Public Policy

How does technology influence the global balance of power?

How can governments strike a balance between innovation and regulation?

How should public policy evolve to ensure technology benefits all of humanity?

This lecture features Prof. Ann Fitz-Gerald, Director of the Balsillie School of International Affairs, who will provide insights into the evolving role of governments in an era of rapid technological advancement and increasing geopolitical complexity.

 

Speaker: Prof. Ann Fitz-Gerald

Director, Balsillie School of International Affairs

Professor, Political Science, Wilfrid Laurier University

Adjunct Professor, University of Waterloo

Hungdah Chiu Memorial Prize Young Scholars Workshop

In commemoration of the contributions of Professor Hungdah Chiu to the field of international law, the International Research Center for International Legal Studies( National Chengchi University), the Chinese (Taiwan) Yearbook of International Law and Affairs, and the Charitable Trust Fund for the Development of Transnational Legal Studies jointly established the "Hungdah Chiu Memorial Prize" in 2021 to reward young scholars in Taiwan engaging in research related to international law. This edition invites scholars and experts in the field of international law to review submissions, selecting the top two finalists for presentation at the Hungdah Chiu Memorial Prize Young Scholars Workshop.

The International Law Young Scholars Forum will be held online on May 24th this year, organized by the Chinese (Taiwan) Yearbook of International Law and Affairs, the International Research Center for International Legal Studies( National Chengchi University), and the Institute of Law for Science and Technology(National Tsing Hua University). Date 2023-11-02

The Research Center for International Legal Studies of National Chengchi University and the Chinese (Taiwan) Society of International Law will hold the 2023 ILA-ASIL Asia-Pacific Research Forum at Howard Civil Service International House in Taipei, Taiwan, ROC. The theme of the Research Forum is “Indo-Pacific Strategies and International Law.”  

 

The Research Forum aims to provide a forum for academics, private practitioners, and government attorneys to present works-in-progress across the spectrum of international and transnational law issues related to the Asia-Pacific.

 

【Event schedule】

The tentative schedule of the Research Forum is as follows:  

    

Sunday, December 3, 2023: Opening Ceremony and Forum Sessions

Monday, December 4, 2023: Forum Sessions and Closing Ceremony

Visiting scholar Kamlesh Kumar Agnihotri has registered at National Chengchi University (NCCU) Department of Diplomacy on April 8, 2024. He is presently a Senior Fellow at the National Maritime Foundation (NMF), India.

Captain (retd.) Kamlesh Kumar Agnihotri is a naval missile and Gunnery specialist.  He commanded a Landing ship in the Andaman and Nicobar Islands. He is a qualified Remote Sensing, satellite imagery interpretation and Photogrammetry analyst.  His specialised field of work for last 17 years has been on Chinese Defense Forces, particularly the Chinese Navy. He has also acquired an Advanced Diploma in Chinese language, to complement his scholarly and research work.

Captain Kamlesh Kumar Agnihotri research period in Taiwan is from April, 2024 to July, 2024 at Department of Diplomacy, College of International Affairs, National Chengchi University. His research title is "Contemporary Taiwan Strait Situation and Global Security Order: India's role in maintaining 'Balance of Power' ".

Date 2024-10-19

[International_Seminar](https://diplomacy.nccu.edu.tw/upload/28/doc/30217/1105-International_Seminar_Preliminary_Agenda-1_page-0001.jpg)

The ongoing geopolitical shifts following conflicts in Eastern Europe and the Middle East, along with the U.S.-China competition, are influencing Pacific relations. East Asia and Latin America, linked through maritime trade since the 16th century, have seen increased economic interactions in recent decades, primarily in trade and investment. The future of both regions will be shaped by the dynamics between Beijing and Washington.

The International Seminar will focus on the current geopolitical landscape and its effects on Latin America and the Asia-Pacific. Hosted by the Department of Diplomacy and the “Madre Ángeles de Dios Trilla” Center for Latin American Studies at National Chengchi University, this event aims to foster academic research on Latin America. We will invite scholars and experts to discuss the following topics:

1. East Asia and Latin America relations in the current decade

2. Economic development in East Asia and Latin America

3. Development of Asian studies in Latin America

4. Development of Latin American studies in Asia

5. China and the United States competition in Asia and Latin America

6. Taiwan and its ties to Latin America

Event information:

Date：05/11/2024 (Tue.)

Time：09:00-18:00

Venue：General Building, North Wing, 5F, International Conference Room

Registration：[https://linktr.ee/Asia_and_Latin_America](https://linktr.ee/Asia_and_Latin_America)

 

 

The detailed agenda will be provided later. If you have any questions, please email 112253018@nccu.edu.tw.

Date 2024-06-20

【The following is a forwarded message.】

VoxCroft Analytics builds language technology for low-resource languages across the globe for a variety of applications. We believe that communities should be able to interact online in their native tongues and not mediate the world through acquired foreign languages. At least half of the world’s 7,000 languages (and the respective cultural identities they represent) face extinction over the next 10-20 years unless we enhance their visibility and recognize their crucial role in shaping identity and participation in public life. Languages that enter the space of digital transformation stand a greater chance of survival.

Join us in contributing to the digital transformation of your language!

VoxCroft is looking for speakers of Hokkien to participate in a Corpus Creation Project to build bilingual language data sets that will be used to train and build language models. Native speakers of Hokkien will be required to complete the following tasks:

Translate sentences from Hokkien to English

Translate sentences from English to Hokkien

Transcribe audio content into Hokkien

Translate Hokkien transcribed sentences to English

Record themselves reading sentences in English and Hokkien

Assess sentences transcribed/translated by peers using VoxCroft’s quality matrix

Improve the quality of transcribed/translated sentences, where necessary

Potential candidates:

Do not need to be professional translators but must display language proficiency in translating written English sentences accurately into Hokkien and from Hokkien into good quality English.

Must portray excellent attention to detail and a good grasp of the spelling and grammar rules in their mother tongue.

Must be available to work at least 15 hours per week over 3-4 months.

Payment is made based on the quality of texts, beginning with a base rate of $0.65 per sentence. The quality assurance task is remunerated at $0.35 per sentence. Sentences that receive top quality scores will receive a bonus on top of the base rate. Improvements to sentences also receive additional remuneration of $0.03 for every confirmed improvement.

Successful candidates will:

Work online remotely,

Must have a computer/laptop and access to reliable Internet for the duration of the contract.

Candidates must have a local currency bank account that accepts international payments.

Candidates must have proof of identification (passport etc.)

All shortlisted candidates will undergo a test, and only those who meet the required standards will be selected.

Work will begin once the contract is signed. All contracted workers will receive training

Interested candidates are requested to upload their CV and a cover letter explaining how they meet this project's requirements.

Referrals of other potential candidates will be awarded with $250.

Further information can be found in: [https://voxcroft-analytics.breezy.hr/p/d0ca99dbf55b-mt-hokkien-linguist](https://voxcroft-analytics.breezy.hr/p/d0ca99dbf55b-mt-hokkien-linguist)

Date 2024-06-20

【The following is a forwarded message.】

VoxCroft Analytics builds language technology for low-resource languages across the globe for a variety of applications. We believe that communities should be able to interact online in their native tongues and not mediate the world through acquired foreign languages. At least half of the world’s 7,000 languages (and the respective cultural identities they represent) face extinction over the next 10-20 years unless we enhance their visibility and recognize their crucial role in shaping identity and participation in public life. Languages that enter the space of digital transformation stand a greater chance of survival.

Join us in contributing to the digital transformation of your language!

VoxCroft is looking for speakers of Hokkien to participate in a Corpus Creation Project to build bilingual language data sets that will be used to train and build language models. Native speakers of Hokkien will be required to complete the following tasks:

Translate sentences from Hokkien to English

Translate sentences from English to Hokkien

Transcribe audio content into Hokkien

Translate Hokkien transcribed sentences to English

Record themselves reading sentences in English and Hokkien

Assess sentences transcribed/translated by peers using VoxCroft’s quality matrix

Improve the quality of transcribed/translated sentences, where necessary

Potential candidates:

Do not need to be professional translators but must display language proficiency in translating written English sentences accurately into Hokkien and from Hokkien into good quality English.

Must portray excellent attention to detail and a good grasp of the spelling and grammar rules in their mother tongue.

Must be available to work at least 15 hours per week over 3-4 months.

Payment is made based on the quality of texts, beginning with a base rate of $0.65 per sentence. The quality assurance task is remunerated at $0.35 per sentence. Sentences that receive top quality scores will receive a bonus on top of the base rate. Improvements to sentences also receive additional remuneration of $0.03 for every confirmed improvement.

Successful candidates will:

Work online remotely,

Must have a computer/laptop and access to reliable Internet for the duration of the contract.

Candidates must have a local currency bank account that accepts international payments.

Candidates must have proof of identification (passport etc.)

All shortlisted candidates will undergo a test, and only those who meet the required standards will be selected.

Work will begin once the contract is signed. All contracted workers will receive training

Interested candidates are requested to upload their CV and a cover letter explaining how they meet this project's requirements.

Referrals of other potential candidates will be awarded with $250.

Further information can be found in: [https://voxcroft-analytics.breezy.hr/p/d0ca99dbf55b-mt-hokkien-linguist](https://voxcroft-analytics.breezy.hr/p/d0ca99dbf55b-mt-hokkien-linguist)

The international Seminar “Asia and Latin America in a Geopolitical Landscape” will take place in Taipei on November 5th, 2024, held by the Department of Diplomacy and the Center of Latin American Studies at National Chengchi University. The goal of the conference is to promote the exchange of the latest developments in regional studies and international relations.

 

MAJOR AREAS AND TOPICS

1. Contemporary East Asia and Latin America relations

2. Economic development in East Asia and Latin America

3. Development of Asian studies in Latin America

4. Development of Latin American studies in Asia

5. China and the United States competition in Asia and Latin America

6. Taiwan and its ties to Latin America

Date 2024-10-19

[International_Seminar](https://diplomacy.nccu.edu.tw/upload/28/doc/30217/1105-International_Seminar_Preliminary_Agenda-1_page-0001.jpg)

The ongoing geopolitical shifts following conflicts in Eastern Europe and the Middle East, along with the U.S.-China competition, are influencing Pacific relations. East Asia and Latin America, linked through maritime trade since the 16th century, have seen increased economic interactions in recent decades, primarily in trade and investment. The future of both regions will be shaped by the dynamics between Beijing and Washington.

The International Seminar will focus on the current geopolitical landscape and its effects on Latin America and the Asia-Pacific. Hosted by the Department of Diplomacy and the “Madre Ángeles de Dios Trilla” Center for Latin American Studies at National Chengchi University, this event aims to foster academic research on Latin America. We will invite scholars and experts to discuss the following topics:

1. East Asia and Latin America relations in the current decade

2. Economic development in East Asia and Latin America

3. Development of Asian studies in Latin America

4. Development of Latin American studies in Asia

5. China and the United States competition in Asia and Latin America

6. Taiwan and its ties to Latin America

Event information:

Date：05/11/2024 (Tue.)

Time：09:00-18:00

Venue：General Building, North Wing, 5F, International Conference Room

Registration：[https://linktr.ee/Asia_and_Latin_America](https://linktr.ee/Asia_and_Latin_America)

 

 

The detailed agenda will be provided later. If you have any questions, please email 112253018@nccu.edu.tw.

[Ann Fitz-Gerald Lecture](https://diplomacy.nccu.edu.tw/upload/28/doc/33300/AnnFitz-Gerald.png)

Topic: Geopolitical Trends, Technology, and the Future of Public Policy

How does technology influence the global balance of power?

How can governments strike a balance between innovation and regulation?

How should public policy evolve to ensure technology benefits all of humanity?

This lecture features Prof. Ann Fitz-Gerald, Director of the Balsillie School of International Affairs, who will provide insights into the evolving role of governments in an era of rapid technological advancement and increasing geopolitical complexity.

Date 2024-12-26

Full-Time Faculty Recruitment for College of International Affairs, National Chengchi University

Field of Specialization: Focus on "Middle Eastern Studies" or "Central Asian Studies," with an emphasis on expertise in Islam, conflict, terrorism or geopolitics studies.

Position: One full-time faculty position at or above the rank of Assistant Professor.

Qualifications:

Educational Requirements: A Ph.D. degree in a relevant field.

Teaching Ability: Capable of teaching in English.

Start Date: August 1, 2025

Required Documents:

Resume, future research plan, and list of academic publications.

Copy of Ph.D. degree certificate (for degrees from foreign institutions, please have the educational documents verified by the nearest Taiwan embassy, consulate or representative office).

Transcripts from Master’s and Ph.D. programs (for non-English transcripts please attach a Chinese translation).

Copies of doctoral dissertation and publications from the last 5 years (up to five items).

Syllabi for four proposed courses on Middle Eastern or Central Asian Studies (at least two course must be taught in English).

Two recommendation letters (can be written in English or Chinese; must be sent directly by the recommenders to the email: dip50916@nccu.edu.tw or mailed to the "Faculty Recruitment Committee, Department of Diplomacy, National Chengchi University").

Application Deadline: 5:00 PM, Monday, March 3, 2025 (Taiwan Time).

Additional Information: Candidates shortlisted after the first-stage review will be invited for an interview and a teaching demonstration.

Application Submission

Both hard copies and soft copies are required.

Send hard copies to:

(Please indicate "New Faculty Recruitment_Applicant’s Name" on the cover and ensure it is delivered by 5:00 PM, Monday, March 3, 2025 (Taiwan Time). Late submissions will not be accepted.)

Department of Diplomacy , North Wing, 9th Floor, General Building, No. 64, Section 2, Zhinan Road, Wenshan District, Taipei City 116, Taiwan.

Soft copies (electronic and scanned files) should be sent to: dip50916@nccu.edu.tw with the title: "New Faculty Recruitment - [Your Name]" (If the file size exceeds 10 MB, use a cloud storage link or send the files in multiple emails.

           (Please submit by 5:00 PM, Monday, March 3, 2025 (Taiwan Time). If you do not receive a confirmation email within 3 business days, please contact our staff in charge, Ms. Chen, at +886-2-2939-3091 ext. 50916 to ensure successful delivery).

Contact information: 

Phone: +886-2-2939-3091 ext. 50916

Email: dip50916@nccu.edu.tw

※Note: Submitted hard copies of application materials will not be returned.

 

 

【國立政治大學國際事務學院徵聘專任教師】

一、名額：助理教授(含)職級以上1人

二、專長：研究領域「中東研究」或「中亞研究」，以伊斯蘭、衝突、恐怖主義或地緣政治研究為優先。

三、資格：

個人履歷表、未來研究計畫及學術著作目錄。

自訂四門與中東或中亞研究相關之擬開授課程授課大綱。(至少二門須為英文授課)

推薦信二封（英文或中文皆可；須由推薦人直接寄到email：dip50916@nccu.edu.tw或郵寄到「國立政治大學外交學系【專任教師甄選委員會】」）。

Date 2025-10-14

[From Berlin to Vienna Exploring Taiwan's Ties with Germany and Austria-s](https://diplomacy.nccu.edu.tw/upload/28/doc/36505/國際事務學院聯合導師活動 From Berlin to Vienna Exploring Taiwan's Ties with Germany and Austria-s.jpg)

[Registration Information](https://reurl.cc/z5vb87)

This event aims to deepen the understanding among students from Taiwan, Germany, and other countries regarding Germany and Austria’s politics, economy, culture, and their interactions with Taiwan. Taiwan’s interactions with Europe—geographically distant across the Eurasian continent—have remained relatively limited. In recent years, however, as global geopolitics are being reshuffled and the international landscape grows increasingly complex, Taiwan’s engagement with Europe and other like-minded regions sharing similar values has become ever more important. Yet, mutual understanding and exchange between Taiwan and European nations have not advanced fast enough to keep pace with these global developments.

We invite three professionals from Germany and Austria to share their insights, enhancing the understanding of NCCU students and the general public regarding both countries and their bilateral relations with Taiwan.

The lecture features three distinguished speakers from Germany and Austria, who will offer in-depth discussions on politics, economics, and cultural exchange:

Julian Goldmann (Head of Education and Science Section, German Institute Taipei) — Germany–Taiwan Political Relations

Nico Cron (Senior Manager for Market Entry, German Trade Office Taipei) — Germany–Taiwan Economic and Trade Cooperation

Christian Helbig (Director, Austrian Office Taipei) — Austria–Taiwan Cultural Exchange

The session will be moderated by Assistant Professor Pei-Lun Tsai from the Department of Diplomacy.

Amid today’s rapidly changing international environment, ties and cooperation between Taiwan and European countries are of growing importance. We invite participants to explore European affairs, and deepen their understanding of Germany and Austria.

All faculty and students are warmly invited to join us in broadening our horizons.

The venue will open for admission at 9:30 a.m., and the event will begin promptly at 9:50. Please be seated early.

 

Speaker: Julian Goldmann, Nico Cron, Christian Helbig

Head of Education and Science Section, German Institute Taipei. Senior Manager for Market Entry, German Trade Office Taipei. Director, Austrian Office Taipei

Date 2025-10-07

[Taiwan: An Unassuming Powerhouse in the Global ICT Industry](https://diplomacy.nccu.edu.tw/upload/28/doc/36369/20251013定稿海報.jpg)

Taiwan: An Unassuming Powerhouse in the Global ICT Industry

 

Topic: Taiwan: An Unassuming Powerhouse in the Global ICT Industry 

Date & Time: Tuesday, November 4, 2025, 10:00 AM – 11:30 AM

Venue: International Conference Hall, 5th Floor, General building, National Chengchi University

Speaker: Dr. Chih-Ke Chueh (General Director of Delta Research Center of Delta Electronics, Inc. )

Registration Deadline: November 1, 2025 (Registration may close earlier if capacity is reached)

Registration Link: [https://moltke.nccu.edu.tw/Registration/registration.do?action=conferenceInfo&conferenceID=X25455](https://moltke.nccu.edu.tw/Registration/registration.do?action=conferenceInfo&conferenceID=X25455)

Contact:114253009@nccu.edu.tw   Ms. Huang

 

Over the last 40 years, Taiwan has successfully morphed into a major player in the global Information and Communication Technology (ICT) industry. Having oscillated among the business models of OEM, ODM and OBM, Taiwan’s ICT companies have eventually found their footing in their ecosystem, as an astute and effective maestro for providing high-quality customer-driven design/manufacturing service, in domains ranging from semiconductor fabrication and electronic system integration to IC design outsourcing. In this talk, I will go over the unique edges and characteristics of these service offerings, and describe how they reflect the style and  sustain the competitiveness of the Taiwanese companies behind them.

 

 

Dr. Chiueh joined Delta in 2021 and currently leads the Delta Research Center in developing advanced technologies and product-grade application services and solutions in the areas of smart manufacturing, artificial intelligence, information security protection, wireless communication sensing, energy storage management software, unmanned vehicles, and life sciences.

Dr. Chiueh graduated from the Department of Electrical Engineering at National Taiwan University, and received a Master's degree in Computer Science from Stanford University and a Ph.D. in Computer Science from the University of California, Berkeley. He specializes in large-scale system software, information and communication security technologies, and computer and network system architectures. Dr. Chiueh has published more than 220 seminar and journal papers. He has also received several best paper awards from internationally recognized institutions, including the U.S. National Science Foundation Career Award, the 2013 TECO Award, the 2016 IEEE Test of Time Paper Award, the 2017 Pan Wen Yuan Outstanding Research Award, and the 2019 Medal of the Year from the Chinese Institute of Engineers.

Date 2022-05-30

[Introducing Jury Systems in East Asia and Beyond - online forum by Professor Rieko Kage](https://diplomacy.nccu.edu.tw/upload/28/doc/17276/event poster.png)

Title: Who Judges?  Introducing Jury Systems in East Asia and Beyond

Time: 9 am, June 14th 2022

Venue: Cisco Webex Virtual Meeting Room (Online)

 

Guest speaker short bio:

Rieko Kage is professor of Political Science at the Department of Advanced Social and International Studies, University of Tokyo.  She received her Bachelor's at Kyoto University and her Ph.D. at Harvard University.  She is the author of the books Civic Engagement in Postwar Japan: The Revival of a Defeated Society (Cambridge University Press, 2011), and Who Judges?  Designing Jury Systems in Japan, East Asia, and Europe (Cambridge University Press, 2017).  Kage has published widely on issues relating to civic engagement, public opinion, immigration, and Japanese politics in the British Journal of Political Science, Comparative Political Studies, Electoral Studies, and Political Psychology, among other journals.

Date 2022-07-22

【Recruitment of 2022 SEASAT camp Counselor】  

 

To young leaders out there: Join us as the camp counselor for an exciting summer!

 

The SEASAT Youth Camp, which is co-organized by the American Institute in Taiwan(AIT) and the Taiwan-Asia Exchange Foundation(TAEF), has the objective to enrich young people, from the age of 18 to 24, in their familiarity with their ASEAN, South Asian, and Taiwanese neighbors with the hopes of promoting better understanding and cooperation among international youths. Youth leaders explore ways in which the younger generation has responded to urgent issues both locally and globally through innovative projects and design their own practical agendas so that voices from the youth can be heard.

To know more about the event, please see the agenda:

[https://docs.google.com/document/d/1lL2uyDFousUXSSs37ZGu-aoDRkf0WaFI/edit?usp=sharing&ouid=113016850758199105077&rtpof=true&sd=true](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1lL2uyDFousUXSSs37ZGu-aoDRkf0WaFI/edit?usp=sharing&ouid=113016850758199105077&rtpof=true&sd=true) 

A new edition of the SEASAT Youth Camp is coming on August 3-5 at Green World Hotel NanGang (528, Sec. 7, Zhongxiao E. Rd., Nangang Dist., Taipei City 115, Taiwan)

 

For those who study international politics and aspire to devote themselves to related careers in the future, we highly recommend you to apply. You can not only better understand the work of think tanks, but also cultivate the literacy and ability to lead and advocate in international exchanges join with joining this event as camp counselor. Now, it's time for you to show your leadership!

 

Those who attend the event will be provided with the following treatments by the organizer: 

-Free lodging from 3th to 5th August, 2022 in a 2 or 3-person room at Green World Hotel NanGang (528, Sec. 7, Zhongxiao E. Rd., Nangang Dist., Taipei City 115, Taiwan)

-Standard meals and refreshments

-Local insurance in the event of unforeseen accidents.

-Local transportation for camp-related activities.

And you will also enjoy wonderful and fulfilling sessions and activities given by professional and prestigious speakers from NGOs, Academia and thinktanks.

-In the sessions, we will learn and share the issues covering “digital,” “education,” “migrants,” “ocean,” “culture,” “resilience,” “activism,” “communication,” and “youth”.The event is going to begin on August 3 at Green World Hotel NanGang.

 

The major responsibilities of the positions will include:

→→To guide group members through discussion.

→→To handle the administrative needs of group members.

→→To record the participation of members.

→→ To assist the organizer in assigning matters

→→Other assignments during the event.

→→Please note that the counselor will be required to attend some working meetings prior to the camp.

This engagement will be absolutely remunerated. Since you have the passion, the experience, and the skills it takes, sign up now! Mail your English CV to the email address: [jo11382001@taef.org](mailto:jo11382001@taef.org)

Note: Foreign students who would like to apply must have a work permit certificate.

Date 2022-09-19

Faculty Position Announcement

National Chengchi University (NCCU), Taipei, Taiwan

 

The Department of Diplomacy at National Chengchi University (NCCU) invites applications for a faculty position in international relations beginning in February or August 2023. The department is recruiting a faculty member in international law, international political economy and/or international development. Candidates in the final stage of completing their degree requirements should possess a PhD one month prior to the start date. 

 

The department encourages all qualified applicants to apply. However, candidates with research and teaching expertise in international law, IPE, and/or international development are more welcome. In terms of areas of specialization, the department prefers the candidates who can teach Asia-Pacific or Middle East that complements our existing teaching and research interests. The candidate will be expected to teach courses and publish academic works in English as well.

 

NCCU is one of the best academic institutions in Taiwan with excellent faculties specialized in international politics and area studies. NCCU is also known for having the best degree programs in humanities, social sciences, and business studies in East Asia. In addition, the school libraries hold one of the most comprehensive collections in humanities and social sciences. 

 

Required Documents:

Curriculum Vitae

A list of publications within five years

Certified diploma

All transcripts from bachelor to PhD degree

Copy of PhD dissertation

Writing samples 

Two reference letters

 

Please mail all documents to the following address by post no later than 5:00 pm, November 21st, 2022. Once we receive your application, the committee will start to review the materials immediately in order to determine short-list candidates for the job talk.

 

Department of Diplomacy, National Chengchi University, No. 64, Sec. 2, Zhinan Rd., Taipei, Taiwan 11605, R.O.C. 

 

Shortlisted candidates will be invited to an interview. Further information is available by contacting Ms. Yi-Hsuan Chen at 886-2-2939-3091 Ext. 50916, or via an e-mail at: [dip50916@nccu.edu.tw](mailto:dip50916@nccu.edu.tw). Applicants are also welcome to visit our website at [http://diplomacy.nccu.edu.tw](http://diplomacy.nccu.edu.tw)

Mr. Brinigar, Ambassador Chin-Yung Chao’s son-in-law, who made the donation with his wife, Tessa Chao, according to Ambassador Chao’s will has donated US$200,000 for the Ambassador Chin-Yung Chao Memorial Scholarship.

We really appreciate his support to our Department.

Ambassador Chin-Yung Chao, a distinguished alumnus of Department of Diplomacy of class of 1938, has donated US$200,000 for the Ambassador Chin-Yung Chao Memorial Scholarship. The scholarship aims to cultivate young talents for Foreign Service and to encourage outstanding students to joint Foreign Service.

who made the donation with his wife, Tessa Chao, according to Ambassador Chao’s will.

Date 2024-04-09

Visiting scholar Kamlesh Kumar Agnihotri has registered at National Chengchi University (NCCU) Department of Diplomacy on April 8, 2024. He is presently a Senior Fellow at the National Maritime Foundation (NMF), India.

Captain (retd.) Kamlesh Kumar Agnihotri is a naval missile and Gunnery specialist.  He commanded a Landing ship in the Andaman and Nicobar Islands. He is a qualified Remote Sensing, satellite imagery interpretation and Photogrammetry analyst.  His specialised field of work for last 17 years has been on Chinese Defense Forces, particularly the Chinese Navy. He has also acquired an Advanced Diploma in Chinese language, to complement his scholarly and research work.

Captain Kamlesh Kumar Agnihotri research period in Taiwan is from April, 2024 to July, 2024 at Department of Diplomacy, College of International Affairs, National Chengchi University. His research title is "Contemporary Taiwan Strait Situation and Global Security Order: India's role in maintaining 'Balance of Power' ".

Date 2023-11-02

The Research Center for International Legal Studies of National Chengchi University and the Chinese (Taiwan) Society of International Law will hold the 2023 ILA-ASIL Asia-Pacific Research Forum at Howard Civil Service International House in Taipei, Taiwan, ROC. The theme of the Research Forum is “Indo-Pacific Strategies and International Law.”  

 

The Research Forum aims to provide a forum for academics, private practitioners, and government attorneys to present works-in-progress across the spectrum of international and transnational law issues related to the Asia-Pacific.

外交學系112學年度轉系申請須知

 

一、申請資格：

1、一年級在原修業學系一年級上學期學業成績總平均75分以上。

2、二年級以上（含二年級）欲轉入本系者需前各學期學業成績總平均75分以上，且至少修習本系認可之本校開設國際關係相關科目一門以上，且平均成績達80分以上者。

二、申請辦法：

1.日期：112年3月6日(一)至3月10日(五)止至本系提出申請，逾時不受理。

（本系洽公時間為上午9-12時，下午1：30-5：00）

2.地點：綜合院館大樓北棟九樓外交學系辦公室（270916室）

3.繳交文件：

Ø  轉系申請表（請登入iNCCU → 校務資訊系統 → 學生資訊系統 → 學術服務→ 學士班學生申請轉系(組)系統，填妥存檔後自行列印轉系申請書）；

Ø  歷年成績單正本

Ø  班級排名表正本

Ø  請繳交一千字以內之書面說明一份，略述轉系動機及未來發展方向。（請以A4尺寸、標楷體、字型大小13，第一頁右上角註明學號、系級、姓名）。需繳交一式四份，並同時寄送電子檔至外交系指定信箱（[dip50916@nccu.edu.tw](mailto:dip50916@nccu.edu.tw)）

Ø  如有其他優異表現請附一份影本證明供參（右上角均須註明學號、系級、姓名）。

Ø  請親自辦理（請攜學生證備查），不受理委託申請。

三、考試方式：

筆試：國際現勢（中英文筆試）

時間：3月20日（一）上午10時10分～11時50分

（預備鈴：10：00，測驗時間：100分鐘）

地點：綜合院館大樓北棟9樓

(考古題請參考本系網站[https://diplomacy.nccu.edu.tw/PageDoc/Detail?fid=4855&id=2086](https://diplomacy.nccu.edu.tw/PageDoc/Detail?fid=4855&id=2086)。）

口試：與轉系審查委員面談

時間：3月27日（一）上午10時10分起(暫定)

（口試順位將於一周前公告於本系網站）

報到地點：外交學系辦公室（綜合院館大樓北棟9樓）

（筆試與口試時皆須攜帶學生證備查）

四、錄取名額：名額上限為10名。

五、錄取公告：依教務處規定，統一公告（約四月下旬）。

詳細資訊請參考[教務處公告](https://aca.nccu.edu.tw/zh/%E8%A8%BB%E5%86%8A%E7%B5%84/%E8%BD%89%E7%B3%BB%E4%BA%8B%E5%AE%9C)

三、考生應試注意事項：

國際現勢筆試（綜合院館北棟二樓270203教室）

考前請再次確認現場公告之「筆試座位表」及「面試時間順序表」並記下面試序號。若有任何疑問，請立即詢問現場工作人員。

請勿提前進入筆試考場。

08：00 預備鈴響，開放入座，入座後未經指示不得翻閱試題、試卷或作答。

08：10 筆試開始，請把握時間；08：30後不得入場；08：50才得交卷離場。 

09：00 筆試結束，鈴聲響畢請立即停筆。

試場注意事項將於入座後宣佈，考試期間請遵守試場人員指示，若有其它需求，請舉手發問。

為維護試場秩序及考試公平，國際現勢筆試悉依本校訂定之「[國立政治大學招生考試試場規則及違規處理要點](https://aca.nccu.edu.tw/zh/常用連結/相關法規1/綜合業務組-1/4379-國立政治大學招生考試試場規則及違規處理要點-2)」為準。

 

面試（綜合院館北棟270918教室）

每人面試時間為7分鐘，面試結束前一分鐘（6分鐘）工作人員將按一聲短鈴「提示鈴」，面試結束時（7分鐘）將按一長鈴「中止鈴」請結束談話；「中止鈴」響後若有面試委員繼續發問者，不在此限。

當日不接受作品展示，所有文件依上傳資料為準

面試結束即可離去，勿於試場逗留。

 

四、考生應試攜帶之物品及文具：

國民身分證正本（附加照片之健保卡、汽機車駕照、護照、居留證）。

文具：原子筆（藍色或黑色）或鋼筆、修正液（帶），其他與考試無關之任何電子產品請勿攜帶。

不得攜帶手機、穿戴式裝置或任何會發出聲響之電子產品，教室內無時鐘，請自備鐘錶。

當日不接受作品展示，所有文件依已繳交資料為準。

 

五、考生若有任何問題，請電詢本系陳助教：

    TEL：02-2939-3091分機50916

    FAX：02-2939-0173

    本系國防學士班招生資訊網站：

    [https://diplomacy.nccu.edu.tw/admiss/recruit.php?Sn=77](https://diplomacy.nccu.edu.tw/admiss/recruit.php?Sn=77)

 

 

如有緊急情事無法準時出席，請提前來電確認。

 

因本校為開放空間，若有不明人士要求留個人資料，請小心防範，以免個資外流。

考前請再次確認現場公告之「筆試座位表」及「面試時間順序表」並記下面試序號。若有任何疑問，請立即詢問現場工作人員。

請勿提前進入筆試考場。

10：00 預備鈴響，開放入座，入座後未經指示不得翻閱試題、試卷或作答。

10：10 筆試開始，請把握時間；11：30後不得入場；10：50才得交卷離場。 

11：50 筆試結束，鈴聲響畢請立即停筆。

試場注意事項將於入座後宣佈，考試期間請遵守試場人員指示，若有其它需求，請舉手發問。

為維護試場秩序及考試公平，筆試悉依本校訂定之「[國立政治大學招生考試試場規則及違規處理要點](https://aca.nccu.edu.tw/zh/常用連結/相關法規1/綜合業務組-1/4379-國立政治大學招生考試試場規則及違規處理要點-2)」為準。

面試（綜合院館北棟9樓報到）

綜合院館北棟九樓教室(270914)於筆試結束後將做為考生休息室；等候期間請保持安靜，避免干擾考試進行，並於面試開始時間前十分鐘完成報到。

每人面試時間為8分鐘，面試結束前一分鐘（7分鐘）工作人員將按一聲短鈴「提示鈴」，面試結束時（8分鐘）將按兩聲短鈴「中止鈴」請結束談話；「中止鈴」響後若有面試委員繼續發問者，不在此限。

當日不接受作品展示，所有文件依上傳資料為準

text:

日期：2023-03-29

李校長於政大NMUN代表團出發前接見外交系老師、助教及代表團成員。

校長與外交系盧業中主任、陳怡萱助教和部分代表團成員在會議室裡聊天瞭解NMUN代表團。

2023政大NMUN代表團全體團員及帶團指導老師黃奎博教授。

【新聞系/外交系 鄧芯怡撰】

國立政治大學「美國全國模擬聯合國會議」（National Model United Nation，簡稱NMUN）代表團於3月28日上午在外交系主任盧業中教授、指導老師黃奎博教授的帶領下，拜會李蔡彥校長，報告因疫情睽違三年後再度前往紐約市參加NMUN的集訓與整備過程。校長親切地和NMUN代表團團員聊天，並不時溫馨叮嚀同學們到美國要注意安全，「以平常心盡力應對，享受學習的過程」。

 

「政大NMUN代表團是台灣少有的長期參加且密集集訓，又是主要由台灣本地同學組成的代表團，過去的參與也不曾交過『白卷』。」帶團多年的黃奎博教授在和校長介紹NMUN代表團時自豪地説道。NMUN由美國全國大專生會議協會 （National Collegiate Conference Association）主辦，聯合國新聞部（United Nations Department of Public Information）協辦，迄今已六十多年，是世界最具權威及最大型的模擬聯合國會議，會議最後一天還可進入聯合國大會議事廳參加閉幕典禮。

盧主任表示，秉著學術交流、訓練多邊外交能力，政大代表團由外交系姜家雄教授自2006年開始籌組、參與，都有極佳的表現，為這届代表團學弟妹帶來不小的「壓力」。政大代表團團長（head delegate）、歷史/外交四年級王尚旻則表示，過去三年因為新冠疫情而無法至紐約親身參與NMUN，今（2023）年在相對沈重的財務負擔下，仍積極組團參與並向校內外募款，終於迎來了這次難得的機會，團員們都非常期待。

 

今年的政大NMUN代表團由曾任外交部研究設計委員會主委的外交系黃奎博教授擔任指導及帶團老師，團員則由7名外交系學士班學生、3名外交系學士班雙主修生及3名外交系碩班生組成。今年的NMUN會議將從4月2日至4月6日進行，為期5天。政大NMUN代表團將以匈牙利代表團的身份出席7個不同委員會的議題討論，包括武力裁減議題、經濟議題、人權議題、環境議題、核能議題等等。政大NMUN代表團自去年10月下旬開始，便進行固定訓練，學習内容包含議事規則、議題探討、英文口説訓練等等。

 

黃奎博教授表示，政大參與NMUN學術活動，不僅訓練自己的學生，還可以和外國的學生們交流，協助推廣政大，對政大的國際形象帶來正面的助益。校長對老師及同學們的努力給予肯定，並希望同學們在學習的過程中，亦可藉此宣揚政大精神，鞏固外交系的形象。

 

除了參與模擬會議，政大NMUN代表團也將利用會前週五及週六時間，經黃奎博教授安排，拜訪美國外交政策全國委員會（National Committee on American Foreign Policy, NCAFP）執行長艾略特（Susan Elliott）大使及董雲裳（Susan Thornton）主任、至紐約大學（New York University, NYU）參加兩岸與美國外交的政策座談會、與在紐約市的外交系系友晤談，並由專人導覽美國華人博物館（Museum of Chinese in America, MOCA）。全體團員相信NMUN此行必將有所收穫，並能為校為國爭光。

text:
[:::](http://diplomacy.nccu.edu.tw/PageDoc/Detail?fid=1520&id=21725#accesskey-l)

日期：2023-03-29

祁凱立博士演講

會眾聆聽祁凱立博士演講

與會者與講者合影

本校外交學系與中華民國國際關係學會於2023年3月24日，共同邀請美國史丹佛大學胡佛研究所研究員祁凱立博士（Dr. Kharis Templeman）以 “Debates in the US over the China threat to Taiwan” 為題發表演講，探討美國是否會為了保衛台灣而與中國開戰。本次座談會由外交學系主任暨國際關係學會會長盧業中教授主持。

 

祁凱立博士首先探討美中為了台灣開戰的可能性，自2016年起雙方對台灣的權力掌控陷入了安全困境，因此加劇兩國發生衝突的可能性。美國方面，自韓戰後便十分重視台灣的安全，希望台海能夠維持和平穩定，台灣能夠持續施行民主制度，因為台灣除了坐落於第一島鏈上，是美國圍堵中國的重要戰略據點外，也是美國十分重要的貿易夥伴，尤其是在晶片的供給上，因此保衛台海的安全對美國來說符合戰略利益。中國方面，自習近平掌權後，國防支出隨著經濟成長而增加，中國解放軍的軍力與品質也逐漸提升，相對來說台灣的軍力則沒有出現較大的提升，兩岸的權力平衡因此出現改變。

 

祁凱立博士也提到台海是否會開戰的爭辯。一派認為過去中國對台灣採取「和平統一」的目標，只要台灣不追求獨立，就未必會侵略台灣，然而近年隨著台灣人民的獨立意識漸長，以及中國軍力逐漸提升，習近平未必會遵循相同的立場，使得武力攻打台灣成為選項的可能性越來越高；美國對台則持續維持戰略模糊的策略，不保證會派兵防衛台灣，因此台海有可能發生戰爭。然而另一派則抱持較樂觀的看法，認為除非美國支持台灣獨立，否則在維持現狀下，台海戰爭未必會發生。此外，中國的經濟成長逐漸出現停滯，內政也面臨隱憂，且中國已經近40年沒有發生戰爭，無法衡量戰爭的效益，因此「武統台灣」將是冒險的決定。另一方面，美國雖然沒有對防衛台灣提出保證，但近年來逐漸將防衛重心轉移至亞太地區，與日本、澳洲進行國防合作，再加上美國與台灣有深厚的貿易連結，因此可以確信美國有防衛台灣的意圖。祁凱立博士也提到，他個人認為美中開戰是可以避免的，而美國對烏俄戰爭的態度可以作為美國是否會防衛台灣的依據。

 

本次活動亦有國家發展研究所魏玫娟教授及外交系陳秉逵教授與會。會後的提問包括中國對台灣外島的侵略、台灣發展核武的可能性、美國戰略模糊策略以及AUKUS的影響力。祁凱立博士認為，若要維持台海和平穩定，最重要的關鍵就是要維持現狀，因此無論是中國對台灣外島侵略或是台灣發展核武都可能增加台海的風險以及開戰的機會。在他的評估中，美國目前仍會維持戰略模糊的策略，但會在亞太增加防務，在不改變基礎外交方針的情況下，提升美澳共同的防禦能力。

 

外交學系將持續結合國際知識社群，努力推廣國內國際關係研究。本學期另安排多場相關議題之演講與座談，歡迎留意本系網站活動公告： [https://diplomacy.nccu.edu.tw/PageDoc?fid=4392](https://diplomacy.nccu.edu.tw/PageDoc?fid=4392)

熊鈺錚學長(右)與校長合影

本校李蔡彥校長於4月23日(日)在行政大樓宴請多位傑出校友餐敘，出席者包含54級李蔚華學長（現任北美校友聯合會理事長）、鍾厚學長、林良榮學姐、蘇瑞璞學長、熊鈺錚學長以及曾奕民學長等多位外交系系友，本系盧業中主任也一同出席。

 

與會的校友素來均對母校事務懷抱熱忱，長年以來大力支持母校與母系的各類活動。席間校長與校友們相談甚歡，對於近期學校經營與校友聯繫相關事務有豐富的意見交流，期盼能讓本校的教學環境與校友服務更臻完善！李蔚華學長更是慷慨解囊捐助母系，以實際行動力挺母系與提攜後進。

 

外交系畢業的學長姐出路非常廣泛，也在各自的領域發光發熱，實為母系的榮耀！許多有關學長姐成功背後的故事、經驗與人生觀，都能藉由每年的系刊、先前出刊的《九十週年紀念文集》與不定期舉行的演講中學習，歡迎外交系的學弟妹們把握寶貴機會！

外交系自106學年度起每學期固定舉辦「國關論壇」，師生反應熱烈、成果卓越，討論議題包羅萬象，舉凡國際安全、國際法、全球化趨勢等。

 

本學期（111-1）將針對不同議題再度召開三場講座，透過本系教授分享目前投入的研究議題，與學生進行國際事務的深入探討與互動，借此提升學生國際視野、更促進師生交流。

 

本學期三場主題及講者分別如下：

10/18（二）12：30－14：00（[9/8開放報名](https://reurl.cc/V1mExn)）

Latin America’s Position Facing an Increasing U.S.-China Rivalry－馮慕文教授

 

11/23（三）12：30－14：00（[10/19開放報名](https://reurl.cc/xQKGyN)）

中國對非洲醫療外援的空間分析（2005-2014）－吳崇涵教授

 

12/21（三）12：30－14：00（[11/24開放報名](https://reurl.cc/LMQ7je)）

烏蘭巴托過程：預防東亞武裝衝突的二軌對話－黃奎博教授

 

在這次的論壇中，同學們將可以與教授們近距離互動並深度探討國際關係議題，歡迎對相關議題有興趣的同學把握這難得的機會，盡速報名！

111學年度外交系學士班選課須知請參照附檔，選課前請務必詳閱，另幾點重要提醒如下：

 

1.學分替代－本系必修（含群修）課程以修習本系開設之課程為原則，如因特殊原因擬修習他系科目名稱、學分數及學期數相同或學分數、學期數較多之相同名稱科目時，修習前需經本系同意，並依必修科目表規定採計學分。

無論您的身份為本系、雙修、輔系學生，如因不可避免之原因而需申請學分替代時，請事先準備好想用來替代的課程，系辦僅承認以多抵少，所以請至少準備好雙倍的課程。來信前請先詳閱選課須知中Email說明，以便系辦以最快的速度回覆。

 

2.如有任何關於學士班選課或學分問題，請寫信至[dip50916@nccu.edu.tw](mailto:dip50916@nccu.edu.tw)或於上班時間電洽02-2939-3091轉校內分機50916陳怡萱助教。因不同身分有不同解決方案，來信或來電請先述明系級、學號、姓名，並條列清楚想問的問題。

 

3.初選後如有任何選課困難需要助教協助，請於開學首二日(9/12-13)，早上9：00-11：30、下午14：00-16：30時親至外交系辦公室（綜合院館北棟9樓）詢問。

4.本須知僅適用於外交系選課，若有其他系所選課問題一律依本校或他系規定為主。

三、考生應試注意事項：

筆試（綜合院館北棟九樓270914教室）

考前請確認現場公告之「筆試座位表」及「面試時間順序表」並記下面試序號。若有任何疑問，請立即詢問現場工作人員。

請勿提前進入筆試考場。

10：00 預備鈴響，開放入座，入座後未經指示不得翻閱試題、試卷或作答。

10：10 筆試開始，請把握時間；11：30後不得入場；10：50才得交卷離場。 

11：50 筆試結束，鈴聲響畢請立即停筆。

試場注意事項將於入座後宣佈，考試期間請遵守試場人員指示，若有其它需求，請舉手發問。

為維護試場秩序及考試公平，筆試悉依本校訂定之「[國立政治大學招生考試試場規則及違規處理要點](https://aca.nccu.edu.tw/zh/常用連結/相關法規1/綜合業務組-1/4379-國立政治大學招生考試試場規則及違規處理要點-2)」為準。

面試（綜合院館北棟270918教室）

綜合院館北棟九樓教室(270914)於筆試結束後將做為考生休息室；等候期間請保持安靜，避免干擾考試進行，並於面試開始時間前十分鐘完成報到。

每人面試時間為8分鐘，面試結束前一分鐘（7分鐘）工作人員將按一聲短鈴「提示鈴」，面試結束時（8分鐘）將按一長鈴「中止鈴」請結束談話；「中止鈴」響後若有面試委員繼續發問者，不在此限。

當日不接受作品展示，所有文件依上傳資料為準

面試結束即可離去，勿於試場逗留。

 

四、考生應試攜帶之物品及文具：

准考證將於考試當日現場發送，不會事先寄送。

國民身分證正本（附加照片之健保卡、汽機車駕照、護照、居留證）。

文具：原子筆（藍色或黑色）或鋼筆、修正液（帶），其他與考試無關之任何電子產品請勿攜帶。

不得隨身攜帶手機、穿戴式裝置或任何會發出聲響之電子產品，教室內無時鐘，請自備鐘錶。

六、疫情期間將不開放陪考人員進入本校建築物內，請陪考人員於本校戶外場地等候，謝謝。

國立政治大學國際事務學院為提升學生國際競爭力及國際移動力，並培育傑出政商學界國際事務人才，特設立「國際事務學院英語授課學分學程」，以下簡稱「本學程」，招生對象為國際事務學院學士班學生，每年招生名額以四十人為原則，歡迎新舊生提出申請。

相關申請辦法：

申請資格：

國際事務學院學士班學生，每年招生名額以四十人為原則。

招生對象為國際事務學院學士班新生為原則，申請資格以達到本校大學英語文課程免修標準為原則，免修標準詳情請見[外文中心公告](https://flc.nccu.edu.tw/zh_tw/course/asumption)

學分修課規定：

學生須至少修畢33學分，始符本學程規定。

選修英語課程需修習至少9學分，含本校外文中心開設之選修英文、本校開設之英語授課學分學程（English Taught Program）之英語訓練專班。不足者得以英語授課之專業課程抵免。

國際事務學院開設之英語授課必修、選修課程至少18學分。

他院開設之英語授課必修、選修課程或赴國外選讀英語授課課程至多6學分。

申請流程：

請於111年8月17日（星期三）下午5:00前 填寫申請表，並上傳英文能力相關證明文件（表單連結：[https://forms.gle/7R3n9srxREscSrUt9](https://forms.gle/7R3n9srxREscSrUt9)）。

國際事務學院將於8月19日（星期五）審核成績後擇優錄取，並公布於國際事務學院網頁。

未足額部分，國際事務學院將另訂時間進行補充招生。

日期：2021-12-07

【外交系訊】本系本學期起與台北市私立延平高中簽訂先修課程備忘錄（MOU），於今（12/6）日舉行簽約儀式，雙方均表示本次合作為一個跨階段、跨領域、多元性的合作，希望合作課程有助於高中學生探索自身興趣，進一步規劃將來的求學或職業生涯，同時跨領域學習更有益於充實學習歷程檔案，培養未來競爭力。

 

本系相信，大學不只是自我探索的殿堂，更是模擬社會的演練場。冉冉4年的時光裡，學生將褪去稚嫩的循規蹈矩，漸漸學著規畫自己未來的航道。但自我規劃的能力絕非一蹴可及，有鑒於此，本系以落實、整合大學端與高中端的學習資源為初心，讓大學先修不再是少數學生的福利，而是每一位惦念著自身將來的學生，都有渠道籌謀自己將來的璀璨人生，減少由高中過渡到大學的那陣徬徨。

 

因應以「素養」為導向108新課綱，大學與高中雙方結合教學能量，合作推動彈性課程。本學期雙方規畫開設多元選修課程「國際關係」，共有近百位高中生選課。課程強調在地區域連結，教導學生國際基礎知識與思考如何與國際連結，目的在陶冶學生們洞悉國際的晶亮眼光，培育具前瞻能力的國之棟樑。

 

期盼所有有志於國際事務的學生，都能在本系精心設計的「國際關係」課程中，發現自己的熱情與天賦。若或有緣，更願學生更能在不遠的將來加入政大外交系的大家庭，讓本系在學生築夢的道路上，一路相伴！

外交系主任盧業中教授、延平高中張漢鏞校長共同簽訂備忘錄

與會人員合影留念

前排左起政大外交系陳秉逵教授、盧業中主任、延平高中張漢鏞校長，後排左起政大外交系楊一逵教授、延平高中馬根善教務主任、彭敬淑學務主任、蕭行恕外語中心主任、張志強總務主任、研發組周建勳組長。

本學期開設「國際關係」多元選修課程，由楊一逵教授授課

110學年度外交系學士班選課須知請參照附檔，選課前請務必詳閱，另幾點重要提醒如下：

 

1.學分替代－本系必修（含群修）課程以修習本系開設之課程為原則，如因特殊原因擬修習他系科目名稱、學分數及學期數相同或學分數、學期數較多之相同名稱科目時，修習前需經本系同意，並依必修科目表規定採計學分。

3.初選後如有任何選課困難需要助教協助，請於開學首二日(非大一：9/13-14；大一：9/22-23)，早上9：00-11：30、下午14：00-16：30時親至外交系辦公室（綜合院館北棟9樓）詢問。因應疫情學校改為遠距教學，故對選課如有任何問題，請於開學首兩日撥打電話至外交系搬公室或是直接透過電子郵件詢問。

**請注意

（一）申報資格：

1. 須修業滿三學期以上

2. 修業規定最低畢業學分數四分之三（二十四學分）

（二）考試方法與規定：

1. 以筆試進行，每科應考時間為三時三十分。

2. 在考前一個月內不得撤回，超過期限後，除休學或因不可抗拒因素以書面報請系主任同意外，不得撤銷，否則視為不通過。

（三）因應新型冠狀病毒（COVID-19），若疫情嚴重(如疫情警戒達三級以上)致無法辦理考試的情況下，將實施應變方案，啟動時間另行公布在本系網頁。

111學年度碩士班、博士班甄試招生考試訊息  [碩士班甄試請點此](https://diplomacy.nccu.edu.tw/PageDoc/Detail?fid=4860&id=2099)  [博士班甄試請點此](https://diplomacy.nccu.edu.tw/PageDoc/Detail?fid=5964&id=3047)

一、本校111學年度碩士班、博士班甄試招生考試招生簡章於110年9月14日上網公告，本項考試不販售紙本簡章，屆時請自行網頁瀏覽或列印，報名前請務必詳閱簡章。提供本項考試招生系所及重要日程表參考，若與簡章內容不符處，以簡章所載為準。

二、報名方式、日期(以下各項皆逾時不受理)：

(一）網路取得報名繳費帳號期間：自110年10月5日上午9時起至10月19日下午5時止。

(二）網路登錄報名資料期間：自110年10月5日上午9時起至10月20日下午5時止。

(三）審查資料繳交截止日：

1.通訊郵寄：110年10月20日前（以郵戳為憑）。

2.網路上傳：110年10月20日下午7時止（逾時不受理）。

※依各系所「資料繳交方式」規定辦理。

三、報名流程：

（一）於報名系統取得繳費帳號。

（二）於報名系統線上以信用卡、金融卡繳款、或至全國金融機構自動提款機（ATM）繳費、第一銀行臨櫃繳款（擇一方式繳費）。

（三）於報名系統填寫個人基本資料，完成報名後下載PDF報名表自行存檔。

（四）依系所規定繳交報名所需相關表件。本項考試之審查資料，部分系所(學程)繳交方式以網路上傳電子檔，部分系所(學程)仍以通訊寄件，詳細繳交方式規定，請詳閱招生簡章系所(學程)分則。

四、若有疑問，請於上班時間（08:30~12:00；13:30~17:00）洽本校教務處綜合業務組(02)2938-7892、2938-7893。

※因應新型冠狀病毒（COVID-19），若疫情嚴重(如疫情警戒達三級以上)致無法辦理考試的情況下，將實施應變方案(請點選下方連結參閱)，啟動時間另行公布在本校「招生專區」網頁。

110學年度第1學期碩士班轉系所辦理規範與外交系碩士班名額：

  一、申請時間：12月1日至12月31日

  二、申請資格：碩士班學生於修業第二學年開始前，經原肄業所及擬轉入所雙方同意，申請轉所，並以一次為限。一般研究所學生與在職專班學生不得互轉，系所經報教育部同意核備有學籍分組者得申請轉組。

  三、申請標準：碩士班辦理轉系所之規定，由各系所自訂並明於修業規定中；相關規定請參閱各系所修業規定。

  四、申請程序：學生填具轉系所申請書，於規定期間內提出申請，經原肄肆業所及擬轉入所雙方主管同意，送教務處複核後，學生原就讀系所應於每學期結束日前將表單正本送註冊組據以處理學  籍等後續事宜。

  五、學分認定：轉所於新學期生效，學生應於轉所生效當學期開課日起二週內填寫學分認定申請書並附成績單，送轉入系所辦理學分認定審核。

  六、110學年度外交系碩士班轉入名額：2位 (不含大陸地區學生名額) / 1位 (大陸地區學生名額)

由TVBS主辦、政大外交系參與合作的的《國際焦點訪談》邀來三度入閣並成為美國內閣首長的台裔美籍政治人物─前運輸和勞工部長趙小蘭
(Elaine Chao)，以「挑戰亞裔政治天花板 時代的先行者」為主題分享看法。讓年輕學子有更多機會參與並了解國際事務，有機會透過媒體，
對國際重量級人士線上提問。
帶領學生參與訪談的政大外交系黃奎博副教授亦表示支持與肯定：「期待透過這次的合作，讓學生從非本土的觀點拓展眼界、審時度勢，並了
解美國社會的極化情形與可能化解之道，為培養年輕學子國際思維向下扎根。」
 

本集訪問內容可參考 [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rUgZTZPy2x0](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rUgZTZPy2x0)

國際事務學院111學年度五年一貫申請公告

 

主 旨：

國際事務學院外交系及修習國際事務學院學程、輔系及雙主修之大學部三年級以上學生，請於111年5月13日（星期五）下午五點前踴躍申請本院碩士班先修生甄選。

承辦人員：

鄭湘縈

承辦單位：

國際事務學院 外交學系

內 容：

依據：「國立政治大學國際事務學院學士班學生五年一貫修讀學、碩士學位鼓勵辦法」辦理。

公告事項：

一、申請資格：國際事務學院學士班學生及修習國際事務學院學程、輔系及雙主修學生前五學期成績累積排名在全系(班)前百分之三十以內者。

二、需檢附資料： 

(一) 申請書；

(二) 歷年成績單及排名證明書；

(三) 自傳及讀書計畫；

(四) 推薦函；

(五) 其他有利審查之文件。

(六)  (1) 申請外交學系五年一貫者，請參考「國立政治大學外交學系學生五年一貫修讀學、碩士學位修讀辦法」。

(2) 申請東亞所、俄羅斯研究所、國際研究英語碩士學位學程(IMPIS)或日本研究碩士學位學程者請參考「國立政治大學國際事務學院學士班學生五年一貫修讀學、碩士學位鼓勵辦法」

三、申請期限：即日起至111年5月13日（星期五）下午五點止。

四、申請方式：申請資料請逕送綜合院館北棟9樓外交學系辦公室鄭助教或於申請期間內電郵至本系。

五、如有疑問，請於上班時逕洽外交系辦鄭助教或電郵[dip50918@nccu.edu.tw](mailto:dip50918@nccu.edu.tw) 聯繫。

三、考生應試注意事項：

國際現勢筆試（綜合院館北棟九樓270914教室）

考前請再次確認現場公告之「筆試座位表」及「面試時間順序表」並記下面試序號。若有任何疑問，請立即詢問現場工作人員。

請勿提前進入筆試考場。

11：00 預備鈴響，開放入座，入座後未經指示不得翻閱試題、試卷或作答。

11：10 筆試開始，請把握時間；11：30後不得入場；11：50才得交卷離場。 

12：00 筆試結束，鈴聲響畢請立即停筆。

試場注意事項將於入座後宣佈，考試期間請遵守試場人員指示，若有其它需求，請舉手發問。

為維護試場秩序及考試公平，國際現勢筆試悉依本校訂定之「[國立政治大學招生考試試場規則及違規處理要點](https://aca.nccu.edu.tw/zh/常用連結/相關法規1/綜合業務組-1/4379-國立政治大學招生考試試場規則及違規處理要點-2)」為準。

面試（綜合院館北棟270918教室）

綜合院館北棟九樓教室(270914)於筆試結束後將做為考生休息室；等候期間請保持安靜，避免干擾考試進行。

每人面試時間為8分鐘，面試結束前一分鐘（7分鐘）工作人員將按一聲短鈴「提示鈴」，面試結束時（8分鐘）將按一長鈴「中止鈴」請結束談話；「中止鈴」響後若有面試委員繼續發問者，不在此限。

當日不接受作品展示，所有文件依上傳資料為準

面試結束即可離去，勿於試場逗留。

 

四、考生應試攜帶之物品及文具：

國民身分證正本（附加照片之健保卡、汽機車駕照、護照、居留證）。

文具：原子筆（藍色或黑色）或鋼筆、修正液（帶），其他與考試無關之任何電子產品請勿攜帶。

不得攜帶手機、穿戴式裝置或任何會發出聲響之電子產品，教室內無時鐘，請自備鐘錶。

當日不接受作品展示，所有文件依已繳交資料為準。

 

五、考生若有任何問題，請電詢本系陳助教：

    TEL：02-2939-3091分機50916

    FAX：02-2939-0173

    本系國防學士班招生資訊網站：

    [https://diplomacy.nccu.edu.tw/admiss/recruit.php?Sn=77](https://diplomacy.nccu.edu.tw/admiss/recruit.php?Sn=77)

 

六、疫情期間將不開放陪考人員進入本校建築物內，請陪考人員於本校戶外場地等候，謝謝。

 

如有緊急情事無法準時出席面試請提前來電確認。

因本校為開放空間，若有不明人士要求留個人資料，請小心防範，以免個資外流。

110學年度第二學期碩士班資格考相關事宜公布

 

本系訂於111年5月23日（一）上午10：00～12：30於270915教室舉行資格考試。

 

請同學在111年4月1日（五）下午5點以前至系辦登記完畢。逾時不候！

※因應疫情，本學期資格考試報名接受現場至系辦報名及電郵報名（[dip50918@nccu.edu.tw](mailto:dip50918@nccu.edu.tw))兩種方式，

惟電郵報名請務必來電確認系辦是否收到信及回信確認。

 

書單資訊請參閱附檔。

 

**請注意

 

1）修業滿兩學期起，碩士班學生得申請參加資格考試。

 

2）學號開頭為101、102、103的同學，須在研究所第四學期（二下）結束前完成並通過資格考試。

 

3）學號開頭為104（含）之後的同學，考試次數至多以三次為限。

※ （1）依107年8月16日經教務處修正核備通過之碩士班修業辦法，自一年 級下學期起，碩士班學生得申請參加資格考試，考試次數至多以三次為限，如三次未通過應予退學。（適用107、108學年度入學之碩士生）

※ （2）依109年5月31日經教務處修正核備通過之碩士班修業辦法，自一年級下學期起，碩士班學生得申請參加資格考試，考試次數至多以三次為限，如三次未通過應予退學。未選定論文題目及指導教授者，不得報名資格考試。碩士班學生之指導教授即為其導師。（適用109、110學年度入學之碩士生）

 

4）如有特殊原因，則須在資格考試舉辦二星期前向系辦公室申請並填寫放棄資格考試聲明書，惟每人以放棄一次為限。

 

5）因應新型冠狀病毒（COVID-19），若疫情嚴重(如疫情警戒達三級以上)致無法辦理考試的情況下，將實施應變方案，啟動時間另行公布在本系網頁。

 

有任何相關疑問請逕洽湘縈助教，謝謝。

110學年度第二學期博士班資格考相關事宜公布

 

本系訂於111年6月24日（五）

 

上午9：00～12：30於270915教室舉行博士班資格考試。

考試科目：國際關係理論（必考）

 

下午2：00～5：30於270915教室舉行資格考試。

考試科目：

學號105、106、107、108：國際法院成案/國際組織/國際政治經濟學 （選考）

學號104（含）之前：請依所選學門應考。

 

請同學在111年4月1日（五）下午5點以前至系辦登記完畢。

※因應疫情，本學期資格考試報名接受現場至系辦報名及電郵報名（[dip50918@nccu.edu.tw](mailto:dip50918@nccu.edu.tw))兩種方式，

惟電郵報名請務必來電確認系辦是否收到信及回信確認。

 

書單資訊請參閱附檔。

 

**請注意

（一）申報資格：

1. 須修業滿三學期以上

2. 修業規定最低畢業學分數四分之三（二十四學分）

（二）考試方法與規定：

1. 以筆試進行，每科應考時間為三時三十分。

2. 在考前一個月內不得撤回，超過期限後，除休學或因不可抗拒因素以書面報請系主任同意外，不得撤銷，否則視為不通過。

（三）因應新型冠狀病毒（COVID-19），若疫情嚴重(如疫情警戒達三級以上)致無法辦理考試的情況下，將實施應變方案，啟動時間另行公布在本系網頁。

日期：2022-02-18

一、申請資格：

1、一年級在原修業學系一年級上學期學業成績總平均75分以上。

2、二年級以上（含二年級）欲轉入本系者需前各學期學業成績總平均75分以上，且至少修習本系認可之本校開設國際關係相關科目一門以上，且平均成績達80分以上者。

二、申請辦法：

1.日期：3月7日至3月11日止至本系提出申請，逾時不受理。

（本系洽公時間為上午9-12時，下午1：30-5：00）

 

2.地點：綜合院館大樓北棟九樓外交學系辦公室（270916室）

3.繳交文件：

轉系申請表（請登入iNCCU → 校務資訊系統 → 學生資訊系統 → 學術服務→ 學士班學生申請轉系(組)系統，填妥存檔後自行列印轉系申請書）

歷年成績單正本

班級排名表正本

請繳交一千字以內之書面說明一份，略述轉系動機及未來發展方向。（請以A4尺寸、標楷體、字型大小13，第一頁右上角註明學號、系級、姓名）。需繳交一式四份，並同時寄送電子檔至外交系指定信箱（[dip50916@nccu.edu.tw](mailto:dip50916@nccu.edu.tw)）

如有其他優異表現請附一份影本證明供參（右上角均須註明學號、系級、姓名）。

請親自辦理（請攜學生證備查），不受理委託申請。

三、考試方式：

筆試：國際現勢（中英文筆試）

時間：3月21日（星期一）上午10時10分～11時40分

（預備鈴：10：00，測驗時間：100分鐘）

地點：綜合院館大樓北棟9樓270914室

(考古題請參考本系網站[https://diplomacy.nccu.edu.tw/PageDoc/Detail?fid=4855&id=2086](https://diplomacy.nccu.edu.tw/PageDoc/Detail?fid=4855&id=2086)）

口試：與轉系審查委員面談

時間：3月28日（星期一）上午10時10分起

（口試順位將於3月22日（二）前公告於本系網站）

報到地點：外交學系辦公室（綜合院館大樓北棟270916室）

（筆試與口試時皆須攜帶學生證備查）

 

四、錄取名額：名額上限為10名。

 

五、錄取公告：依教務處規定，統一公告（五月上旬）。

未盡事宜請見教務處公告：[https://aca.nccu.edu.tw/zh/註冊組/轉系事宜](https://aca.nccu.edu.tw/zh/註冊組/轉系事宜)

三、考生應試注意事項：

國際現勢筆試（綜合院館北棟九樓270914教室）

考前請再次確認現場公告之「筆試座位表」及「面試時間順序表」並記下面試序號。若有任何疑問，請立即詢問現場工作人員。

請勿提前進入筆試考場。

11：00 預備鈴響，開放入座，入座後未經指示不得翻閱試題、試卷或作答。

11：10 筆試開始，請把握時間；11：30後不得入場；11：50才得交卷離場。 

12：00 筆試結束，鈴聲響畢請立即停筆。

試場注意事項將於入座後宣佈，考試期間請遵守試場人員指示，若有其它需求，請舉手發問。

為維護試場秩序及考試公平，國際現勢筆試悉依本校訂定之「[國立政治大學招生考試試場規則及違規處理要點](https://aca.nccu.edu.tw/zh/常用連結/相關法規1/綜合業務組-1/4379-國立政治大學招生考試試場規則及違規處理要點-2)」為準。

面試（綜合院館北棟270918教室）

綜合院館北棟九樓教室(270914)於筆試結束後將做為考生休息室；等候期間請保持安靜，避免干擾考試進行。

每人面試時間為8分鐘，面試結束前一分鐘（7分鐘）工作人員將按一聲短鈴「提示鈴」，面試結束時（8分鐘）將按一長鈴「中止鈴」請結束談話；「中止鈴」響後若有面試委員繼續發問者，不在此限。

當日不接受作品展示，所有文件依上傳資料為準

面試結束即可離去，勿於試場逗留。

 

四、考生應試攜帶之物品及文具：

國民身分證正本（附加照片之健保卡、汽機車駕照、護照、居留證）。

文具：原子筆（藍色或黑色）或鋼筆、修正液（帶），其他與考試無關之任何電子產品請勿攜帶。

不得攜帶手機、穿戴式裝置或任何會發出聲響之電子產品，教室內無時鐘，請自備鐘錶。

當日不接受作品展示，所有文件依已繳交資料為準。

 

五、考生若有任何問題，請電詢本系陳助教：

    TEL：02-2939-3091分機50916

    FAX：02-2939-0173

    本系國防學士班招生資訊網站：

    [https://diplomacy.nccu.edu.tw/admiss/recruit.php?Sn=77](https://diplomacy.nccu.edu.tw/admiss/recruit.php?Sn=77)

 

六、疫情期間將不開放陪考人員進入本校建築物內，請陪考人員於本校戶外場地等候，謝謝。

 

如有緊急情事無法準時出席面試請提前來電確認。

因本校為開放空間，若有不明人士要求留個人資料，請小心防範，以免個資外流。

日期：2022-02-17

110學年度第二學期碩士班資格考相關事宜公布

 

本系訂於111年5月23日（一）上午10：00～12：30於270915教室舉行資格考試。

 

請同學在111年4月1日（五）下午5點以前至系辦登記完畢。逾時不候！

※因應疫情，本學期資格考試報名接受現場至系辦報名及電郵報名（[dip50918@nccu.edu.tw](mailto:dip50918@nccu.edu.tw))兩種方式，

惟電郵報名請務必來電確認系辦是否收到信及回信確認。

 

書單資訊請參閱附檔。

 

**請注意

 

1）修業滿兩學期起，碩士班學生得申請參加資格考試。

 

2）學號開頭為101、102、103的同學，須在研究所第四學期（二下）結束前完成並通過資格考試。

 

3）學號開頭為104（含）之後的同學，考試次數至多以三次為限。

※ （1）依107年8月16日經教務處修正核備通過之碩士班修業辦法，自一年 級下學期起，碩士班學生得申請參加資格考試，考試次數至多以三次為限，如三次未通過應予退學。（適用107、108學年度入學之碩士生）

※ （2）依109年5月31日經教務處修正核備通過之碩士班修業辦法，自一年級下學期起，碩士班學生得申請參加資格考試，考試次數至多以三次為限，如三次未通過應予退學。未選定論文題目及指導教授者，不得報名資格考試。碩士班學生之指導教授即為其導師。（適用109、110學年度入學之碩士生）

 

4）如有特殊原因，則須在資格考試舉辦二星期前向系辦公室申請並填寫放棄資格考試聲明書，惟每人以放棄一次為限。

 

5）因應新型冠狀病毒（COVID-19），若疫情嚴重(如疫情警戒達三級以上)致無法辦理考試的情況下，將實施應變方案，啟動時間另行公布在本系網頁。

 

有任何相關疑問請逕洽湘縈助教，謝謝。

外交系辦公室 敬上

日期：2022-05-13

由TVBS主辦、政大外交系參與合作的的《國際焦點訪談》邀來三度入閣並成為美國內閣首長的台裔美籍政治人物─前運輸和勞工部長趙小蘭
(Elaine Chao)，以「挑戰亞裔政治天花板 時代的先行者」為主題分享看法。讓年輕學子有更多機會參與並了解國際事務，有機會透過媒體，
對國際重量級人士線上提問。
帶領學生參與訪談的政大外交系黃奎博副教授亦表示支持與肯定：「期待透過這次的合作，讓學生從非本土的觀點拓展眼界、審時度勢，並了
解美國社會的極化情形與可能化解之道，為培養年輕學子國際思維向下扎根。」
 

本集訪問內容可參考 [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rUgZTZPy2x0](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rUgZTZPy2x0)
新聞稿出處 [https://news.tvbs.com.tw/politics/1790538](https://news.tvbs.com.tw/politics/1790538)
